entities.summary: Niclas Kroon is a former tennis player from Sweden. The right-hander turned pro in 1986 and reached his career-high singles ranking on the ATP Tour of World No. 46 in December 1989. His best performance at a Grand Slam came at the 1990 French Open, where he reached the fourth round. Nicklas Kroon was a athletes & competitors from Karlstad (b. 1966-02-05, Karlstad). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
